Anthropic's 1-hour cache-TTL write multiplier (2x input) is not modeled as a separate field - only the 5-minute TTL rate (1.25x input) is recorded in cacheWrite, noted on every period. Adding a second cache-write field for the 1-hour TTL is a schema change for a future revision.

Fast mode ($10.00/$50.00 for Claude Opus 5 and Claude Opus 4.8, research preview, first-party API only) is not modeled: it is a per-request speed option, not a separate model, and this schema has one rate per model per period.

The 1.1x data-residency multiplier (inference_geo: "us" on Claude 4.6 and later) and the 10% regional/multi-region endpoint premium on Bedrock and Google Cloud are not modeled: both are per-request routing modifiers, not per-model rates.

Contextwindow is recorded only where the models overview page states it (the current lineup plus the 4.6-4.8 generation). Legacy and limited-availability models omit the field rather than carry a guessed value.

Non-token pricing is out of scope for this per-million-tokens schema: web search ($10 per 1,000 searches), code execution ($0.05 per container-hour beyond 1,550 free hours), and Claude Managed Agents session runtime ($0.08 per session-hour).
